result.title: SHIN: Scalable Hierarchy for INcremental 3D Gaussian Splatting
result.comment: 8 pages of main text (13 pages including references and supplementary material), 7 figures
result.summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides high-quality real-time novel-view synthesis, but deployment budgets vary across devices and network conditions. Most compact methods target one operating point, so another budget requires a separate representation. SHIN is a scalable 3DGS hierarchy with a reusable Base and additive enhancement layers, so each higher-quality operating point extends rather than replaces the decoded representation. Constructing this hierarchy requires deciding which Gaussians each stage adds and how much spherical-harmonic (SH) appearance each retains, because these choices remain fixed in later prefixes. SHIN derives one shared Gaussian order from multi-scale position-scale sensitivity and divides each stage budget between adding Gaussians and retaining SH bands using calibrated gradient-based scores per byte. Lightweight opacity updates adjust compositing while transmitted geometry and SH coefficients remain unchanged. Across three benchmarks, SHIN progressively improves one cumulative representation and achieves the best PSNR-size efficiency in every overlapping comparison with the multi-rate and progressive baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SHIN，一种可扩展的 3D Gaussian Splatting 分层表示，由可复用 Base 与增量增强层组成，并按多尺度位置-尺度敏感度统一排序、用基于梯度的「每字节」得分在各阶段分配新增高斯与保留球谐带宽。
